criticisms: The term 'Andean subduction zone' is used without a brief plain-language explanation (e.g., 'where one tectonic plate slides under another'), which could lose non-technical readers.

The report uses emoji icons as section markers rather than traditional headings, which may not render well in all distribution formats (email, PDF, printed briefings) and could appear informal in official emergency communications.

The final bullet on monitoring priorities blends two distinct geographic zones (Kermadec–Tonga and Indonesia arcs) into one sentence, which slightly reduces scannability for readers trying to act on specific regions.
